title: Re-timing mortality risk through individualized modelling of lifespan trajectories

summary: 基于视网膜照片与基础模型构建RetiME生物标志物，欧洲队列训练并在三个独立外部队列验证，可关联死亡风险并重建个体寿命轨迹。

abstract: There is an urgent global need for affordable, large-scale health screening to enhance preventive care in the ageing population. Using low-cost, non-invasive retinal photographs and leveraging large foundation models, we developed a deep learning-based biomarker, Retinal Mortality Equivalent (RetiME), that directly mapped retinal features to individual mortality risk. Trained on a European cohort and externally validated across three independent external cohorts spanning Southeast Asia, Eurasia and North America, RetiME showed robust associations with all-cause and cause-specific mortality and predicted the incidence of a wide range of systemic and ocular diseases. Crucially, beyond static risk estimation, RetiME re-timed mortality risk by reconstructing personalized lifespan trajectories that were associated with observed mortality outcomes (for example, age of death). Clustering of these trajectories revealed distinct mortality patterns, spanning cancer-predominant, cardiometabolic and neurodegenerative risks, reflecting diverse ageing pathways captured by RetiME. Interpretability analyses showed that RetiME captures diverse biological and retinal features underlying mortality risk. Genome-wide analyses further identified genetic loci associated with RetiME. Collectively, these findings support further evaluation of retinal imaging and trajectory modelling as one component of a comprehensive assessment of mortality risk.
zh_abstract: 全球迫切需要可负担的大规模健康筛查，以加强老龄人群的预防性照护。利用低成本、非侵入性的视网膜照片，并借助大型基础模型，我们开发了一种基于深度学习的生物标志物——视网膜死亡等效物（Retinal Mortality Equivalent, RetiME），其将视网膜特征直接映射至个体死亡风险。RetiME 在欧洲队列中训练，并在覆盖东南亚、欧亚和北美的三个独立外部队列中进行外部验证，显示出与全因死亡和特定原因死亡的稳健关联，并可预测多种系统性疾病和眼部疾病的发生率。关键在于，除静态风险估计之外，RetiME 还通过重建与观察到的死亡结局（例如死亡年龄）相关的个性化寿命轨迹，对死亡风险进行了重新定时。对这些轨迹进行聚类揭示了不同的死亡模式，涵盖以癌症为主、心脏代谢和神经退行性风险，反映了 RetiME 所捕捉到的多样化衰老通路。可解释性分析显示，RetiME 捕捉到了死亡风险背后的多样化生物学和视网膜特征。全基因组分析进一步识别出与 RetiME 相关的遗传位点。总体而言，这些发现支持进一步评估将视网膜成像和轨迹建模作为死亡风险综合评估的一个组成部分。

title: A prospective randomized study of patient-centered AI for clinical visit preparation
zh_title: 面向就诊准备的患者中心 AI 前瞻性随机研究
summary: arXiv 预印本报告 802 名美国成人的前瞻性随机研究，评估 LLM 就诊准备智能体在提升就诊准备度上的效果。

abstract: Patients often arrive at brief, time-constrained clinical visits unsure of what to expect or ask, and millions of adults now turn to general-purpose AI chatbots to prepare beforehand. Yet whether conversational AI improves visit readiness remains unclear. We designed a large language model (LLM)-based visit preparation agent to guide patients before an appointment by gathering clinical context, setting visit expectations, providing relevant health information, building a prioritized list of questions for their clinician, and generating a summary. In a prospective consented randomized study in the Google Health app, 802 U.S. adults held 866 health-related conversations with the visit preparation agent (standard or concise variant) or a minimally prompted control chatbot built on the same LLM. The visit preparation agent significantly outperformed the control across blinded clinician evaluations and patient self-reports. In clinician reviews of completed sessions (n = 272), the agent achieved a 16.6% higher rate of comprehensive preparation (67.2% vs. 50.6%; P < 0.05) and an 8.5% higher rate of alignment with patients' health context (98.9% vs. 90.4%; P < 0.01), while maintaining high medical safety and appropriateness across all study arms. Patient post-surveys (n = 460) showed 16.8% higher visit preparedness (73.8% vs. 57.0%; P < 0.01), 14.3% higher confidence in knowing what to ask (81.4% vs. 67.1%; P < 0.01), and 12.0% higher overall satisfaction (74.0% vs. 62.0%; P < 0.05). Clinician and participant metrics were not significantly correlated, indicating that expert review and patient self-assessment capture complementary dimensions of patient-facing AI. These findings suggest that LLM chatbots can safely help patients prepare for clinical visits, with greater benefit when following a structured workflow, and motivate future studies on in-visit communication and clinical outcomes.
zh_abstract: 患者常常在短暂、时间受限的临床就诊中到来，却不确定会有什么预期或该问什么；如今数百万成年人转向通用人工智能聊天机器人以提前准备。然而，对话式 AI 是否能改善就诊准备度仍不清楚。我们设计了一种基于大语言模型（LLM）的就诊准备智能体，通过在预约前收集临床背景、设定就诊预期、提供相关健康信息、构建按优先级排列的向临床医生提问的问题清单，并生成摘要，来指导患者。在 Google Health 应用中进行的一项前瞻性、知情同意的随机研究中，802 名美国成年人使用就诊准备智能体（标准版或简版）或基于同一 LLM 构建的最低限度提示对照聊天机器人进行了 866 次健康相关对话。在盲法临床医生评估和患者自我报告中，就诊准备智能体均显著优于对照。在临床医生对已完成会话的审查中（n = 272），该智能体的全面准备率高出 16.6%（67.2% 对 50.6%；P < 0.05），与患者健康背景的一致性率高出 8.5%（98.9% 对 90.4%；P < 0.01），同时在所有研究组中维持了较高的医疗安全性和适当性。患者后测调查（n = 460）显示，就诊准备度高出 16.8%（73.8% 对 57.0%；P < 0.01），对知道该问什么的信心高出 14.3%（81.4% 对 67.1%；P < 0.01），总体满意度高出 12.0%（74.0% 对 62.0%；P < 0.05）。临床医生指标与参与者指标无显著相关性，表明专家审查和患者自我评估捕捉了面向患者的人工智能的互补维度。这些发现表明，LLM 聊天机器人可以安全地帮助患者为临床就诊做准备，遵循结构化工作流程时获益更大，并推动未来关于就诊中沟通和临床结局的研究。

abstract: AbstractIn the past year, the medical field's relationship to clinical AI has progressed from rapid and often speculative adoption toward evaluation of its impact on patient outcomes, clinical workflows, and society. Drawing from the Symposium on AI for Learning Health Systems (SAIL) Year in Review (May 2026), this Perspective examines six key areas that dominated the domain of clinical AI in the past year: clinical AI evaluation, workflow integration, direct-to-consumer applications, regulation and societal impacts, AI in medical education, and foundational advancements in technology. AI's successes across these areas have been uneven, reflecting its jagged frontier. We highlight milestones that illustrate what AI has already achieved in health care, its potential, and major challenges that remain ahead. (Funded by the Eunice Kennedy Shriver National Institute of Child Health and Human Development of the National Institutes of Health [grant number T32HD040128].).
zh_abstract: 摘要：在过去一年中，医学领域与临床AI的关系已从快速且往往带有推测性的采用，转向评估其对患者结局、临床工作流程和社会的影响。本文借鉴学习型健康系统人工智能研讨会（Symposium on AI for Learning Health Systems，SAIL）年度回顾（2026年5月），考察过去一年主导临床AI领域的六个关键方面：临床AI评估、工作流程整合、直接面向消费者的应用、监管与社会影响、医学教育中的AI，以及技术的基础性进展。AI在这些领域取得的成功并不均衡，反映出其“参差不齐的前沿”。我们重点介绍一些里程碑，以说明AI在医疗保健中已经取得的成就、其潜力以及未来仍面临的主要挑战。（由美国国立卫生研究院下属的尤妮斯·肯尼迪·施莱弗国家儿童健康与人类发展研究所资助[资助编号 T32HD040128]。）

title: PharmaAgent: a real-world evaluation of high- and low-autonomy agentic systems for inpatient vancomycin dosing

abstract: Vancomycin has a narrow therapeutic window requiring individualized dosing and repeated monitoring, a process health systems delegate from physicians to pharmacists for consistency. We silently deployed PharmaAgent, LLM-based vancomycin dosing agentic systems, at Stanford Hospital for two months and compared high- and low-autonomy configurations, each with and without institutional guidelines. Across 403 dosing events in 316 patients, mean absolute percentage error against the treating pharmacist's order was 21.8% with high autonomy versus 37.8% with low autonomy, and recommendations were within 25% of the order in 73.4% versus 50.9% of events (P < 0.001); a second pharmacist was within 25% in 90.2%. Pharmacist review of 196 out-of-tolerance recommendations found a safety concern in 65.8%, more often with low autonomy (odds ratio 2.37). A higher-autonomy agent that self-debugged its intermediate steps proved more robust than stricter engineering, but neither configuration is ready to dose patients without pharmacist oversight.
zh_abstract: 万古霉素治疗窗窄，需要个体化给药和反复监测，这一流程由卫生系统从医师委托给药师以保证一致性。我们在斯坦福医院静默部署了基于LLM的万古霉素给药智能体系统PharmaAgent，为期两个月，并比较了高自主性与低自主性配置，每种配置分别在有和没有机构指南的情况下运行。在316名患者的403次给药事件中，与治疗药师医嘱相比的平均绝对百分比误差在高自主性下为21.8%，低自主性下为37.8%；推荐意见与医嘱相差在25%以内的事件分别占73.4%和50.9%（P < 0.001）；第二位药师的相差在25%以内比例为90.2%。药师对196条超出容差范围的推荐意见进行审查，发现65.8%存在安全性顾虑，低自主性下更常见（比值比2.37）。一个会自我调试其中间步骤的更高自主性智能体被证明比更严格的工程化设计更稳健，但两种配置均未准备好在没有药师监督的情况下为患者给药。

abstract: [Neurosurgical focus] The 2021 WHO CNS tumor classification marked a fundamental shift in neuro-oncology: molecular markers rather than histological appearance now define glioma diagnosis and guide treatment. Yet, in clinical practice the molecular information that matters most to a surgeon-IDH status, 1p/19q codeletion, and methylation class-typically arrives days to weeks after the operation it was meant to inform. Artificial intelligence (AI) is beginning to close that gap. Over the past several years, a growing body of work has demonstrated that AI models can extract diagnostically relevant molecular and histological information from data sources available in the operating room, in real time, at the point of surgical decision-making. In this review, the authors provide a comprehensive overview of state-of-the-art intraoperative AI models available to neurosurgeons during brain tumor resections. They examine AI-augmented approaches to established intraoperative techniques, such as cryosection and fluorescence-guided surgery, before turning to novel technologies including nanopore sequencing and stimulated Raman histology (SRH). The authors conclude by discussing barriers to widespread clinical adoption and what lies ahead for this field. For cryosection, models such as LGNet and the Cryosection Histopathology Assessment and Review Machine (CHARM) have demonstrated strong performance on intraoperative discrimination of primary CNS lymphoma and molecular subtyping of glioma, respectively, with CHARM achieving areas under the receiver operating characteristic curve of 0.88-0.93 across glioma subtypes. In fluorescence-guided surgery, hyperspectral imaging combined with machine learning has enabled classification of tumor type, grade, and IDH mutation based on the 5-aminolevulinic acid (5-ALA) signal with up to 93% accuracy, extracting molecular information from a modality already present in the operating room. For nanopore-based methylation classification, ensemble models such as Rapid Nanopore Brain Intraoperative Classification (ROBIN) have achieved 90% concordance with the final diagnosis prospectively in under 2 hours. In SRH, foundation models for infiltration detection now outperform FLAIR, contrast enhancement, and 5-ALA fluorescence in identifying tumor margins, while molecular classification models have achieved over 90% glioma subtype accuracy in multi-institutional cohorts. title: Algorithmic design choices as determinants of health equity: a causal simulation study of healthcare resource allocation
zh_title: 算法设计选择如何影响医疗资源分配公平性
summary: 基于 All of Us 约 20 万成年人电子病历与调查数据的模拟研究，评估三种算法设计选择对资源分配公平性的影响。
key_points: 分析队列含 201,216 名成年人

abstract: Background. Care management programs increasingly rely on prediction algorithms to decide which patients receive limited healthcare resources. Because these algorithms are typically trained to predict future healthcare utilization or cost, they may systematically underidentify patients whose care-seeking behavior is suppressed by structural barriers. Objective. To evaluate how three modifiable design choices (selection threshold, feature set, and training objective) affect allocation equity in care management targeting. Methods. We constructed an analytical cohort of 201,216 adults from linked electronic health record and participant survey data in the NIH All of Us Research Program (2017-2019). Three prediction models (logistic regression, random forest, and XGBoost) were trained and evaluated under simulation conditions that varied one design choice at a time while holding the others fixed. Equity was assessed using false negative rate (FNR), equal opportunity difference (EOD), and allocation rate conditional on need (an access-independent benchmark based on self-reported general health status). We also applied Oaxaca-Blinder decomposition to identify which predictors contributed most to the Black-White allocation gap. Results. Prior utilization understated self-reported health burden among disadvantaged groups: 33% of Black and 32% of Hispanic participants reported fair or poor health, yet only 22% and 19% were classified as high utilizers. White participants showed the opposite pattern: 25% were classified as high utilizers, while only 19% reported fair or poor general health status. Under baseline design choices, all three models produced similar disparities, with uninsured participants showing the largest gap (EOD: -0.148). Oaxaca-Blinder decomposition identified prior outpatient visits as the dominant contributor to the Black-White gap in predicted allocation, with higher average emergency department utilization among Black participants partially offsetting the effect. Varying the selection threshold had little effect; disparities persisted across all thresholds. Feature set variation produced mixed and group-specific effects; removal of prior outpatient visits achieved near-zero Black-White EOD (0.001, AUC: 0.77), consistent with the Oaxaca-Blinder decomposition finding. summary: 综述总结深度学习等在非小细胞肺癌影像、病理与分子数据中用于检测、分型、生物标志物预测与预后评估的进展。

abstract: [Journal of environmental pathology, toxicology and oncology : official organ of the International Society for Environmental Toxicology and Cancer] Non-small-cell lung cancer (NSCLC) represents the majority of lung cancer cases and remains the leading cause of cancer-related mortality worldwide. Early detection, accurate staging, and individualized therapy are crucial for improving patient survival. Recent advances in artificial intelligence (AI) have transformed NSCLC care through the automated analysis of imaging, pathology, and molecular datasets. Deep learning (DL) and machine learning (ML) models, particularly convolutional neural networks (CNNs), have demonstrated high accuracy in tumor detection, histologic classification, biomarker prediction (PD-L1, EGFR, KRAS) and prognosis assessment. Integration of the AI with whole slide imaging (WSI), computed tomography (CT), PET/CT and liquid biopsies enables non-invasive tumor characterization, early recurrence detection and prediction of treatment response. Multimodal AI approaches that combine imaging, genomic, and clinical data offer superior patient stratification and personalized treatment planning compared with traditional methods. Beyond diagnosis, AI facilitates therapeutic development through radiomics based nodule classification, multi-omics data interpretation, and drug discovery. Radiomics, in particular, extracts quantitative imaging biomarkers that capture tumor heterogeneity beyond human perception. The AI further supports clinical decision-making in surgery, radiotherapy, and systemic therapy, enhancing workflow efficiency. Despite challenges in data quality, interpretability, and clinical adoption, AI holds significant promise for advancing precision oncology and improving outcomes in NSCLC management.
zh_abstract: [Journal of environmental pathology, toxicology and oncology : official organ of the International Society for Environmental Toxicology and Cancer] 非小细胞肺癌（non-small-cell lung cancer, NSCLC）占肺癌病例的大多数，并且仍然是全球癌症相关死亡的主要原因。早期发现、准确分期和个体化治疗对于提高患者生存率至关重要。人工智能（artificial intelligence, AI）的最新进展通过自动分析影像、病理和分子数据集，改变了NSCLC的诊疗。深度学习（deep learning, DL）和机器学习（machine learning, ML）模型，尤其是卷积神经网络（convolutional neural networks, CNNs），在肿瘤检测、组织学分类、生物标志物预测（PD-L1、EGFR、KRAS）和预后评估方面表现出高准确度。AI与全切片成像（whole slide imaging, WSI）、计算机断层扫描（computed tomography, CT）、PET/CT和液体活检的整合，能够实现无创肿瘤表征、早期复发检测和治疗反应预测。结合影像、基因组和临床数据的多模态AI方法，与传统方法相比，可提供更优的患者分层和个体化治疗规划。除诊断外，AI通过基于影像组学的结节分类、多组学数据解释和药物发现促进治疗开发。尤其是影像组学，可提取超越人类感知的定量影像生物标志物，以捕捉肿瘤异质性。AI进一步支持外科、放疗和全身治疗的临床决策，提高工作流程效率。尽管在数据质量、可解释性和临床采用方面存在挑战，AI在推进精准肿瘤学和改善NSCLC管理结局方面具有重大前景。

title: Decision-only medical AI: early evidence and pairing with language models

summary: 预印本测试两种决策式模型与一个大语言模型在2134个病例上的稳定性，配对后标签与压力诱因引起的决策改变降低约42%–81%。

abstract: Recently introduced decision-only AI returns probabilities over specified options rather than text. We tested the clinical consistency and potential bias susceptibility of the two available decision models, Jev and OpenAI Decisions, against a large language model (LLM), GPT-6 Luna, then paired each decision model with the LLM. Across 2,134 case presentations and 2,483,222 model calls, we measured decision changes after adding labels or pressure cues without changing clinical findings. In the original controlled challenges, these additions changed 13.4 more decisions per 100 than neutral wording for the decision models and 14.0 for the LLM. Pairing reduced this to 2.6, about 81% lower in development and 42% to 48% lower in held-out reports. Triage accuracy stayed near 81% to 82%. The paired Decisions workflow cost at most US$0.77 per 1,000 entries. We see this as a practical proof of concept for reducing framing sensitivity and flagging influential text for review.
zh_abstract: 近期引入的仅做决策的 AI 返回的是指定选项上的概率，而非文本。我们测试了两种可用决策模型 Jev 和 OpenAI Decisions 相对于大语言模型（LLM）GPT-6 Luna 的临床一致性和潜在偏差易感性，然后将每个决策模型与 LLM 配对。在 2,134 份病例呈现和 2,483,222 次模型调用中，我们测量了在不改变临床发现的情况下添加标签或压力提示后的决策变化。在最初的对照挑战中，对于决策模型，这些添加每 100 次决策中改变的决策数比中性措辞多 13.4 次，而 LLM 多 14.0 次。配对后这一数值降至 2.6，在开发集中降低约 81%，在留出报告中降低 42% 至 48%。分诊准确率保持在 81% 至 82% 附近。配对的 Decisions 工作流程每 1,000 条记录的成本至多为 0.77 美元（US$0.77）。我们认为这是降低框架敏感性和标记有影响力文本以供审查的实用概念验证。

title: MATS: A Multi-Agent Framework for Controllable and Reflective Tumor Synthesis

summary: 预印本提出多智能体框架，按肿瘤形态属性分布做生成规划，并以两阶段扩散生成跨器官肿瘤掩膜与纹理。
key_points: 先刻画形态属性分布并制定生成计划
两阶段扩散分别生成肿瘤掩膜与纹理
闭环反思机制校验生成质量
reason: 预印本新方法有清晰设计，但仅见摘要、无外部验证与开源说明
abstract: Synthesizing realistic tumors on medical images helps address data scarcity for clinical AI. Existing diffusion-based methods, however, lack fine-grained attribute-level controllability, closed-loop quality verification, and awareness of which morphological patterns are underrepresented in the target distribution. We present MATS, a multi-agent framework for text-controllable, cross-organ tumor synthesis. Given a target disease, MATS first profiles its morphological distribution over a fine-grained attribute space covering tumor geometry and appearance, and constructs a generation plan that amplifies underrepresented subtypes while keeping common ones dominant. It then localizes the target organ, proposes anatomically valid placement, and executes two-stage diffusion to produce the tumor mask and render texture, each conditioned on the corresponding attributes. A closed-loop reflective mechanism verifies attribute alignment at three checkpoints throughout synthesis and provides targeted feedback to guide re-generation when misalignment is detected. Trained exclusively on a single-source pancreatic neuroendocrine tumor dataset, MATS consistently improves downstream segmentation both in-domain and across LiTS, KiTS, and MSD-Pancreas benchmarks, whereas most prior generative augmentation methods fall below real-only training.
zh_abstract: 在医学图像上合成逼真肿瘤有助于解决临床AI的数据稀缺问题。然而，现有基于扩散的方法缺乏细粒度属性级可控性、闭环质量验证，以及对目标分布中哪些形态模式代表性不足的感知。我们提出MATS，一种用于文本可控、跨器官肿瘤合成的多智能体框架。给定目标疾病，MATS首先在涵盖肿瘤几何和外观的细粒度属性空间上刻画其形态分布，并构建生成计划，以扩增代表性不足的亚型，同时保持常见亚型占主导。然后定位目标器官，提出解剖学上有效的放置方案，并执行两阶段扩散以生成肿瘤掩膜并渲染纹理，每一步均以相应属性为条件。闭环反思机制在合成全过程的三个检查点验证属性对齐，并在检测到错位时提供针对性反馈以指导重新生成。MATS仅在单源胰腺神经内分泌肿瘤（pancreatic neuroendocrine tumor）数据集上训练，却在域内以及跨LiTS、KiTS和MSD-Pancreas基准上持续改善下游分割，而大多数既往生成式增强方法低于仅用真实数据训练。

abstract: [International journal of medical informatics] Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly used across clinical, administrative, and public health settings, but technical performance alone does not establish clinical utility, safety, equity, or sustainability. To critically analyze contemporary healthcare AI applications, characterize source types and non-ordinal evidence profiles in the supporting literature, synthesize key opportunities and risks, and identify governance requirements for clinically useful, safe, equitable, and responsible implementation. We conducted a critical narrative synthesis using PubMed, the Virtual Health Library, Web of Science, and Scopus as source-discovery tools on July 16, 2026. A curated corpus of 28 bibliographically verifiable publications was assembled judgmentally to provide complementary coverage of clinical applications, evidence characteristics, implementation, risk, and life-cycle governance. Sources were classified by primary design and non-mutually exclusive evidentiary domains, and the evidence described within them was characterized using non-ordinal profile categories. Findings were synthesized qualitatively because of substantial heterogeneity across technologies, settings, and source designs. The curated corpus addressed diagnosis and imaging, prediction and monitoring, clinical documentation, conversational systems, public health, hospital operations, and specialty applications. Within this assembled corpus, technical-performance/validation and process-utility/workflow domains were represented more often than clinical or patient-safety outcomes, economic outcomes, or post-deployment surveillance; these document-level counts are descriptive and have no inferential weight beyond the selected sources. Reported or proposed benefits included diagnostic support, personalization, documentation, surveillance, and workflow efficiency. Recurrent risks included poor generalizability, bias, miscalibration, hallucinations, opacity, privacy concerns, interoperability problems, inappropriate automation, unclear accountability, and hidden costs. Within this non-exhaustive corpus, the evidence more consistently supported assistive, context-specific uses than generalized autonomous replacement. Responsible implementation requires a clearly defined intended use, governed data, contextual validation, risk-proportionate human oversight, traceability, equity and safety assessment, continuous monitoring, and procedures to restrict, suspend, or withdraw systems when performanc

abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: University College, London; conditions: Sensorineural Hearing Loss, Tinnitus; type: OBSERVATIONAL; enrollment: 84; status: ENROLLING_BY_INVITATION] Background and study aims Hearing problems are becoming more common. In the UK around 18 million adults have hearing loss or hear ringing or buzzing in their ears, which is called tinnitus. Many people wait a long time to be seen, partly because there are not enough audiologists - the specialists who test hearing and treat hearing problems. The standard hearing test is called pure-tone audiometry. An audiologist plays quiet sounds at different pitches through headphones and the person presses a button each time they hear one. The test is accurate, but it takes 20 to 30 minutes to complete, and needs a trained audiologist for all of that time. For people with tinnitus and comorbidity it can be especially tiring and slow. The research team has built a version of this test that uses artificial intelligence, called AI-PTA. Instead of following a fixed pattern, it chooses each sound based on the responses already given, which should mean fewer sound presentations are needed to find the same result. The audiologist stays with the person throughout and remains in charge of the test. This study asks three questions. 1. Does AI-PTA give the same hearing results as the standard test? 2. Is it quicker? 3. And do patients and staff find it acceptable? Who can participate? Adults aged 18 or over who have been diagnosed with sensorineural hearing loss, either with or without tinnitus, and who are due to attend the Royal National ENT \& Eastman Dental Hospital in London. abstract: Automatic radiology report generation (RRG) aims to translate medical images into diagnostic text, reducing radiologists' workload and standardizing clinical documentation. Nonetheless, existing approaches mainly focus on single-timepoint analysis and fail to capture temporal disease evolution across longitudinal examinations. While recent longitudinal RRG (LRRG) approaches incorporate historical data, they often combine images from different time points within a single representation space, leading to blurred semantics and inconsistent temporal reasoning. In this work, we propose a Temporal Decoupling with Iterative Mutual-Refinement Model (TIM), a two-stage framework that explicitly decouples spatial pathology from temporal progression and iteratively refines reports through mutual feedback.
